project.title: StayWeave — Your hotel, wherever you are
project.audience: Nebius and NVIDIA hackathon judges; independent hotel operators
project.objective: Demonstrate owner language driving constrained, visible hotel operations

audio.status: Script only; human narration not recorded

scenes.visual: Owner away from the desk; show actual phone-sized composer.
scenes.action: Open the app; keep pending work visible.
scenes.proof: Observed responsive owner UI and actual model report runs, local synthetic ledger.

copy.voiceover: A host should not need to be at the front desk to keep the hotel moving. This is StayWeave.

scenes.visual: Enter one staff report in chat.
scenes.action: Type a currently valid synthetic operating report; submit once.
scenes.proof: Observed responsive owner UI and actual model report runs, local synthetic ledger.

copy.voiceover: Tell StayWeave what changed. Nemotron, running through Nebius Token Factory, interprets the report and selects the operating tool. The model does not invent availability or staff capacity.

scenes.visual: Show exact task or resource changes and owner limits.
scenes.action: Open interpreted report; inspect plan; record the verified report.
scenes.proof: Observed responsive owner UI and actual model report runs, local synthetic ledger.

copy.voiceover: The operating engine checks existing work, confirmed stays and the owner’s limits. You see what would change before the report is recorded. Feasible recovery can then run inside those limits.

scenes.visual: Show saved automatic result beside genuine handover exception.
scenes.action: Show recorded linen increase and Jules handover; do not falsely complete active work.
scenes.proof: Actual calls, preservation checks and exact saved linen state.

copy.voiceover: The linen count is saved and read back. An absent inspector already has work in progress, so StayWeave asks for a real handover. Automation stops where the facts or permission stop.

scenes.visual: Two guest requests; hard sea requirement versus preference.
scenes.action: Use existing guest intake and joint coordination; guests explicitly choose their own options.
scenes.proof: Existing live guest intake and explicit selection. Rehearse again before filming.

copy.voiceover: The same operating state also serves your guests. Natural-language needs become required conditions and preferences. Requests are considered together. Existing bookings stay protected, and each guest reviews and chooses their own stay.

scenes.visual: Show saved booking and actual changed breakfast/preparation.
scenes.action: Open chosen stay impact; show only changed values.
scenes.proof: Existing live guest intake and explicit selection. Rehearse again before filming.

copy.voiceover: A guest’s choice becomes a reservation and a connected operating plan. Breakfast follows the stay dates. Cleaning and linen are added only when preparation is needed. A ready room does not create imaginary work.

scenes.visual: Tablet calendar and phone chat side by side.
scenes.action: Interact with actual iframe app; use no animated mock results.
scenes.proof: Real responsive app in illustrative frames; not a deployed or native app.

copy.voiceover: On a phone, the host can use the conversation. On a tablet, the same records become a room calendar or a spatial view. These are responsive local app views.

scenes.visual: Expand actual model, latency and estimated-cost evidence.
scenes.action: Open per-request evidence; distinguish estimate from billed spend.
scenes.proof: Actual calls, preservation checks and exact saved linen state.

copy.voiceover: Every model call exposes its measured latency and estimated token cost. Nebius inference is live. Reservations and operations are saved locally; external booking platforms and payments are not connected.

scenes.action: Hold the working product, not an invented growth metric.
scenes.proof: Observed responsive owner UI and actual model report runs, local synthetic ledger.

copy.voiceover: StayWeave. The operating partner for a host who cannot always be at the desk.
